blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fuel prices are rolled back anew this Tuesday by as much as P5.80 per liter. The Department of Energy said diesel prices would drop by P3.80 and gasoline by P1.50 per liter. Kerosene will have the biggest drop at P5.80 per liter. READ: Oil price cuts may extend next week This marks the third week of rollbacks for diesel and kerosene and the second for gasoline.
